thread:
sarah_fin: Heads up — late vendor invoice posted today for reserved prepay (CloudRack INV-998). Looks like ~$42,300 of capacity that was supposed to be billed in Apr landed in our May billing export. Might need a rev rec adjustment or realloc of prepay buckets before close.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-998 uploaded to /invoices/2024/05/INV-998.pdf by vendor-accounting@cloudrack.com — amount $42,300 — PO 4821.

matt_ops: Is this covered by a committed capacity contract or a separate spot purchase?

sarah_fin: Committed capacity; contract ID CR-2023-4821. Vendor typo flagged the invoice date as 05/03 instead of 04/28, so the system put it in May. Contractually it belongs to Apr prepay schedule.

linda_acct: If it's Apr liability we should true-up prepay deferrals and recognize revenue against Apr usage buckets. Need a JE suggestion and signoff.

jordan_sales: Confirming the customer usage that consumed that capacity was in Apr — we ran the bulk eval on 4/27. Sales doesn't object to moving recognition.

matt_ops: We should also check if our billing export lag played a role. Running quick BigQuery to confirm:
```
SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, export_date FROM billing.exports WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-998';
```

billing-bot: Export shows export_date = 2024-05-03, invoice_date = 2024-04-28 (vendor PDF date). System ingestion keyed on export_date.

linda_acct: Proposed temporary JE to fix month-end:
- Debit: Prepaid expense / deferred revenue 42,300
- Credit: Accounts payable (or cash if already paid) 42,300
Narrative: Reclass vendor invoice to Apr prepay bucket per contract CR-2023-4821.

sarah_fin: Can we do that with a post-close reclass (if Apr close already started) or do we need an adjusting journal now?

linda_acct: Close not locked yet — we have a 24h window. Doing now is cleaner. I'll prepare the JE in NetSuite. Need an approval from finance lead / controller. @cecilia_fin PTAL.

cecilia_fin: Quick q — any impact to revenue deferral schedules beyond GL movement? i.e., does this create a one-time catch-up recognition that could skew our SaaS-like metrics?

sarah_fin: It shifts $42.3k from May deferral into Apr schedule. It'll bump Apr recognized rev if the usage bucket was already marked consumed. Net revenue delta by month: +42.3k Apr, -42.3k May. No change to ARR.

cecilia_fin: Ok — that movement is fine. Approve JE subject to: (1) attach vendor PDF, (2) note ingestion/export lag root cause in ticket, (3) confirm customer usage lines in support export.

linda_acct: Got it. I'll attach docs and create ticket in FIN-OPS-254 for ingestion follow-up. Preparing JE now.

matt_ops: FYI, I'll add a logging check to flag invoices where invoice_date < export_date by >2 days so we catch these before close.

jordan_sales: Thanks. Also pinging contracts to remind vendor to fix their invoice date feed.

sarah_fin: Thanks everyone — I'll mark this thread as resolved after JE posts. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: JE created draft JE-2024-5543 (net_suite) status: DRAFT, amount: 42,300, assigned to linda_acct.
